title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot voice support in Word & PowerPoint.
description: Chat in Work and PowerPoint now supports voice. Users can talk and interact with Copilot to brainstorm ideas, create content, and analyze information. Same as text, voice understand documents, work and web context.
